Nego date and Bank fields needed to update negotiation information against multiple invoice

## Business Requirement
In export sales, invoices are submitted to banks for negotiation. Currently, there is no structured way to update and track:
• Negotiation Date
• Negotiation Bank
• Remarks
Against multiple Sales Invoices from the Account Receivable invoice list.

## Purpose
This enhancement will:
• Improve bank reconciliation control
• Track invoice-to-bank negotiation mapping
• Support export finance monitoring
• Reduce Excel dependency
• Improve audit traceability
This is a governance upgrade, not just UI improvement.

## Scope
This enhancement applies:
• Ability to update bank negotiation information directly from AR Sales Invoice List
• Bulk update capability by using Import / Export option
• Enable / Disable fields through Screen Layout Configurator

## Solution

## Ability to update bank negotiation information directly from AR Sales Invoice List
The following fields will be added:

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 3 rows · columns: Field Name (text), Type (text), Field Length (text), Editable (boolean), Mandatory (boolean)]
| Field Name | Type | Field Length | Editable | Mandatory |
| Nego Bank | Text | 200 | Yes | No |
| Nego Date | Date | Date | Yes | No |
| Remarks | Text | 800 | Yes | No |
Navigation: F/A > Account Receivables > Sales Invoice > List
• These fields will appear at the end of the invoice list grid
• Add these fields in the Data model

## Bulk update capability & Import / Export option
Available via 3-dot menu or toolbar.
A. Copy Below
Copies values to next row.
B. Copy to All
Copies values to all selected rows.
C. Multi-Select Update
User selects multiple invoices → Edit → Apply value to selected
Import / Export Functionality:
Export
• CSV format
• Includes:
• Invoice No
• Customer
• Invoice Date
• Invoice Value
• Currency
• Nego Bank
• Nego Date
• Remarks
Import
• CSV upload
• Mandatory column: Invoice No
• System matches invoice
• Updates:
• Nego Bank
• Nego Date
• Remarks
Validation:
• Invoice must exist
• Invoice must not be Closed/Cancelled
• Date format validated
• Error report generated if mismatch
• Nego Date cannot be earlier than Invoice Date
• If Nego Bank entered → Nego Date mandatory

## Enable / Disable fields through Screen Layout Configurator
All these 3 column fields will be enabled or disabled through SLC.
Navigation: Admin > Configurator > Screen Layout Configurator

## Acceptance Criteria:
• Handling of fields from SLC
• Check bulk update option – All 3 options
• Check import & export functionality
